DRAFT AGENDA
Children’s Health Consultant Advisory Committee (CHCAC) Retreat
Tuesday, March 18, 2025, 9:30 A.M.
1055 West 7th Street, Conference Room 100, 1st Floor
Los Angeles, CA 90017

WELCOME
Tara Ficek, MPH, Chairperson
1. Approve today’s meeting Agenda
2. Public Comment
3. Approve the January 21, 2025, Meeting Minutes
4. Chairperson’s Report
5. Introduction: L.A. Care’s Chief Executive Officer - Martha Santana-Chin
• Threats to Medi-Cal
6. Federal Landscape: Policy and Funding Shifts - Cherie Compartore, Erika Witt
7. Local Context: Immunizations - Muntu Davis, MD, MPH
8. Closing Statements
ADJOURNMENT

Board of Governors
Children’s Health Consultant Advisory Committee (CHCAC)
Meeting Minutes – January 21, 2025
Summary of discussions: Member Alex Li, MD, reported on the impact of the recent wildfires in Los Angeles County, noting that nine staff members lost their homes and over 200 evacuated. Martha Santana-Chin assumed the role of CEO on January 6. Dr. Sameer Amin provided updates on the School Behavioral Health Incentive Program (SBHIP) and quality improvement efforts for dental care and childhood immunizations. A presentation was given on Four L.A. County Children's Health Policy Briefs focusing on vaccine catch-up, family resiliency, child welfare, and complex medical needs transitioning to adulthood. Smita Malhotra, MD, discussed school responses to L.A. wildfires, noting the loss of Palisades Charter Elementary School.

Presentation: Federal Policy Shifts and Implications for Pregnant People and Young Children
Presented by Cherie Compartore (L.A. Care) and Erika Witt (First 5 LA).
Key points:
- Federal funds comprise 34.6% of the California state budget ($170.6 billion).
- Medi-Cal is 62.1% federally funded ($112.1 billion).
- Proposed federal budget resolutions include significant cuts to Medicaid ($880 billion over 10 years).
